purpose: Focused TPS specialist capability table on naturally gated strict-double-cold unseen-reaction queries; production model/router unchanged.

test_set.selection: take every fold2 query activated by the already-frozen TPS semantic gate; no ranking metric, rank change, or outcome is used for inclusion

unseen_reaction_audit.interpretation: All 18 selected queries are unseen reactions relative to the paired fold2 training split.

comparison.before: same frozen BRIDGE core scores with TPS specialist contribution disabled
comparison.after: same frozen BRIDGE core scores with the frozen TPS specialist contribution enabled

notes: This is a specialist-capability view conditioned only on the frozen TPS applicability gate.
The 18-query subset is the complete gate-active subset of the 1,042-query strict-double-cold fold2, not a post-hoc best-performing subset.
Whether the TPS specialist itself saw a reaction during its domain-specific training is intentionally not used as an inclusion criterion for this table.
